reviews.author: Brandon M.
reviews.text: Best barbershop experience in town hands down. The attention to detail on the skin fade and beard line is unmatched. Clean shop, great vibes, and always on time.

reviews.author: David K.
reviews.text: The hot towel VIP treatment is incredible. Precision razor work, relaxing atmosphere, and premier customer service. I won't let anyone else touch my hair.

reviews.author: Carlos R.
reviews.text: Elena gave me one of the cleanest tapers I have ever had. The line-up is immaculate and the shop atmosphere is top tier. Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Tyler S.
reviews.text: Jay's freestyle razor art is insane. If you want a custom design with razor sharp accuracy, this is the only place to go.

faqs.question: Do you take walk-ins or are appointments required?
faqs.answer: Walk-ins are always welcome during all regular business hours! However, to guarantee your preferred chair and craftsman without waiting, we highly recommend booking online in advance.

faqs.question: Where are you located and is there parking available?
faqs.answer: We are located at 740 S 4th St, Las Vegas, NV 89101 near 4th St & Gass Ave in the Downtown Arts District. We have ample, free dedicated parking directly in front of the lounge.

faqs.question: What payment methods do you accept?
faqs.answer: We accept all major credit/debit cards (Visa, Mastercard, AMEX, Discover), Apple Pay, Google Pay, Booksy direct pay, and cash.

faqs.question: What is included with a signature haircut?
faqs.answer: Every signature haircut includes a consultation, precision clipper/scissor cut, hot lather razor neck cleanup, hair styling with premium matte products, and aftershave tonic.
